content.title: THE ORGANS ON YOUR BODY'S {{PRIORITY LIST}} AND WHAT THEY'RE ASKING FOR
facts: **Gallbladder** - Beets, Olive oil, Lemon. Beets contain betaine, which helps thin and move bile so it flows smoothly instead of thickening into stones.
**Pancreas** - Spinach, Broccoli, Turmeric. Spinach is loaded with B vitamins and antioxidants that protect pancreatic cells from oxidative stress.
**Bladder** - Cranberries, Watermelon, Celery. Cranberries contain compounds that stop bacteria from sticking to the bladder wall.
**Thyroid** - Brazil nuts, Eggs, Seaweed. Just 2 Brazil nuts a day supply enough selenium to support healthy thyroid hormone conversion.
**Liver** - Garlic, Grapefruit, Leafy greens. Garlic activates liver enzymes that flush out toxins before they build up.
**Joints** - Salmon, Walnuts, Cherries. Tart cherries are one of the few foods that naturally lower uric acid, easing joint stiffness.
**Bone marrow** - Red meat, Lentils, Pumpkin seeds. These iron-rich foods give marrow the raw material it needs to keep producing fresh blood cells.
**Follow along** - for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Your gallbladder works harder than most people realize, and beets are one of its best allies - the betaine inside them keeps bile thin and flowing instead of letting it crystallize over time. Your thyroid, tucked quietly in your neck, runs almost entirely on selenium, and just 2 Brazil nuts a day can cover what it needs to convert hormones properly. And don't sleep on your bladder - cranberries aren't just a UTI home remedy myth, the compounds in them physically stop bacteria from gripping onto the bladder lining in the first place. Everyone's body is different, so pay attention to what yours responds to.
